notes.title: The Epic game Update is Coming!
notes.content:
Thanks for the long waiting and support. The very big update of Tale of Fallen Dragon is releasing.

As what we promised, we added brand new characters, totally improved graphics, and developed online 2-player gameplay/

Maybe you are wondering, where is the old character going?

Actually, this is a completely new version, the background is happened in [Mytries of clud], which is another world of 3000 desperate areas. So the story and characters are all somehow different in the game.

[h1]But please don't worry, the old savedate is still there[/h1]
Once you enter the folder, running HiddenDragons, you can launch the old version of Tale of Fallen Dragons.

\Steam\steamapps\common\Tale of Fallen Dragons

Even though we are in early access. but we still don't want to take the old players' effort away, so we decide to keep the old version. So we didn't make the update as a dlc. Hope you guys can understand.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27452574/962ba3c4935b7ae81ea2a1a3ff1bdaa3f3a8d6ce.png[/img] 

Thanks for the support of you guys. Hope have a nice game experience!

tags.feature: we added brand new characters, totally improved graphics, and developed online 2-player gameplay/
So the story and characters are all somehow different in the game.
